newsitem.title: USA: Crawford, Swiss Re to merge claims service.
newsitem.headline: Crawford, Swiss Re to merge claims service.

text.p: Crawford & Co said Friday it had signed a provisional agreement with Swiss Reinsurance Co to merge their claims services firms outside the United States.
The company said the new entity, to be named Crawford-THG Ltd, will combine Swiss Reinsurance's Thomas Howell Group with its foreign operations.
It said it will own 60 percent of the entity, while Swiss Re will have the remaining amount.
The deal is to be completed by the end of the year, it added.
As part of the agreement, Crawford & Company said it will also acquire 100 percent of Swiss Reinsurance's THG-Americas unit, which specializes in large commercial property claims.
The new entity is projected to have $200 million in annual revenues with offices in about 50 countries, it said.
